description: The IEA hydrogen projects database lists projects worldwide that produce hydrogen for energy or climate-mitigation purposes, compiled by the International Energy Agency to track low-carbon hydrogen technology. The IEA metadata on the Energydata.info listing states that it covers all projects commissioned since 2000, both those that reduce emissions from producing hydrogen for existing uses and those that use hydrogen as an energy carrier or industrial feedstock in new applications, and that projects in planning or construction are included. The current IEA product name adds infrastructure projects, and the IEA also presents the production projects on an interactive map and in its hydrogen tracker. Coverage is global. The database is distributed as an Excel workbook from the IEA website; the Energydata.info copy is the 2021 revised edition, marked as not open and subject to the IEA terms and conditions, with no price shown on that listing (free of charge there). The IEA product page could not be read on the day of cataloguing because of a bot check, so access terms for the current edition should be checked there. Caveats: announced projects often change or are cancelled, and terms restrict redistribution. Simulation uses are pipelines of planned electrolysers and hydrogen plants for capacity expansion and hydrogen network scenarios. Related records: data-scigrid-gas and data-entsos-tyndp-scenarios cover gas and hydrogen networks in Europe.
